BSP-Core Reference Sheet

29 plates in the order a player meets things: the totem and its powers, the three metals and their machines, coins, Wave Plasma, decoys and admin blocks, with every recipe where it is first needed. Each plate is 800 x 600; add ?plate=N to show one.

The Shatter Totem

BSP-Core

Left to right below: unclaimed, owned, and being stolen.

  • Everyone gets one on their first join. It cannot be crafted or destroyed, only stolen.
  • Place it and it projects your base powers in a cube around it. Carry it and it powers you.
  • Steal one by standing at a rival's totem until the timer runs out: five minutes by default. The owner is warned the moment it starts.
  • Nothing makes a totem safe. No power, no block, no trick. That rule is not going to change.
  • It stays in play. A dropped totem can only be picked up by its owner, and one put into a storage system comes straight back.
  • Coins and seasons. Powers are bought with Shatter Coins and XP; every totem scores by its tier on the season leaderboard.
Friends go on the ACCESS tab: up to eight players who pass your Alarm and Ward, may buy powers, or may open your machines.

Ores drop raw chunks, like iron; the machines take chunks and ore blocks alike

All three also generate in the AllTheModium mining dimension. Fortune works on them, and any crusher from another mod can turn the ingots into dust, but no other mod can smelt the ore: nuggets only ever come out of the Tetrium Crucible, the Illyrium Crucible and the Magnetic Centrifuge.

Ore blocks are tagged forge:ores, so other mods' tools and X-rays recognise them.

Tetrium Crucible and Combination Forge

BSP-Core

Tetrium Crucible

A furnace with a bigger idea. Burns any furnace fuel and turns one Tetrium Ore or raw chunk into 2 Tetrium Nuggets and 1 Tetrium Slag in 15 seconds. Keep the slag.

Combination Forge

Presses nine nuggets into an ingot, Tetrium Ingots into Tetrium Plates, and with the Illyrium Forge Upgrade nine Illyrium Nuggets into an ingot. Fuel, or RF twice as fast with an RF Upgrade.

Wave Plasma: the totem's power on tap

BSP-Core

Totem on an extractor, interfaces beside it, cables out to a Projector Base with its Projector, and a second run into the back of a Battery Charger. A valve and a repeater sit in the long run.

How it flows

A placed totem gives off 100 mB/t, up to 6,000 with Output. Touching interfaces join into one body of up to twelve, and each face sends up to 1,000 mB/t, shared equally between the runs leaving it.

CableRunCarries
Tetrium15 blocks250 mB/t
Magnatite25 blocks500 mB/t
Illyrium40 blocks1,000 mB/t
Charged Illyrium80 blocks1,000 mB/t

A repeater starts a fresh run for a tenth of the pressure. A valve caps a run or shuts it by redstone. A projector needs 100 mB/t and its base holds 5,000 mB.

Right-click any interface for the flow view: the whole network in 3D with the mB/t on every cable. Jade reads the figures block by block.

The plasma blocks

BSP-Core

Extractor and interfaces

Touching interfaces join into one body, up to twelve. A thirteenth, or one touching an extractor another group holds, turns red and does nothing.

Projector Base

A tank the Totem Projector stands on. Cables plug into its sides; the level shows through its windows. Right-click the projector to choose which powers it receives.

Plasma Valve

Sets the most that may pass, from its screen. A lever on it or any redstone signal shuts it. The wheel turns with the limit.

Plasma Repeater

One way: in through the dark back, out through the lit front. Starts a fresh run. The wrench turns it.

Powers pass a valve unchanged. Behind a repeater a projector receives one power at full level, or several each a level lower per repeater.

Plasma Tank and Plasma Injector

BSP-Core

Plasma Tank

A hollow box of Tank Casing edges, Tank Glass or casing faces and Tank Ports, 3 to 12 blocks a side. It forms by itself when the last block goes in: a sweep of light runs over it, the shell turns to glass with lit rails, and the corner uprights glow as high as the plasma stands. 2,500,000 mB for every shell block. Ports take plasma from an interface run and feed bases, chargers and other tanks.

Plasma Injector

A column placed against any machine, cable on the far end. Feed it and the machine runs faster the more arrives: twice the speed at 300 mB/t, three times at 500. Works on every BSP machine, on a coin factory slice through a Motivator cell, and on other mods' machines. Cut the cable and it drops back to normal in a second.

Plasma Interfacea run inTank Portruns out, a face's worth eachProjector Base+Battery Charger+Plasma Injector
Plasma Injector300 mB/t: twice the speed
500 mB/t: three timesCombination Forge
Overclock travels with the plasma: every injector fed from a totem with Overclock is stronger, by a quarter to double its speed-up by level. Tank plasma carries no Overclock.

Batteries, cells and the Wave Emitter

BSP-Core

Battery Charger

Cable into its back. Fills the battery or cell standing in it and stamps the interface's powers into it. Hoppers and pipes may feed empties in and take full ones out on any other side.

Wave Emitter, Power Cells, Wrench

The emitter runs on a cell in your offhand and gives you its Carried powers at 20 mB/t, with the totem safe at home. The wrench sets cable ends and turns repeaters.

Plasma Batteries

Four tiers. Stood on an extractor instead of a totem, a battery feeds the network with its stamped Base powers, so everything keeps working while the totem is away, or stolen.

TierHoldsPowers
Battery I to IV40k / 200k / 1M / 5M mB0 / 2 / 3 / 4 Base
Cell I to III8k / 24k / 60k mB1 / 2 / 3 Carried
Every battery and cell is built round a Charged Resonance Crystal: a Resonance Crystal magnetised in the centrifuge with a Magnatite Nugget in the upgrade slot.

Coloured cables and cable ends

BSP-Core

Sixteen colours

Magnatite, Illyrium and Charged Illyrium cables take any dye: eight cables round a dye, and dye again to change. A coloured cable joins only its own colour and a plain one only plain ones, so runs cross without mixing.

Wrench-set ends

Point the wrench at the end of a cable and right-click to set it: Normal, Output (plasma only leaves there), Input (only enters), Off (not joined), or Linked where another colour may join.

One Output end at a base stops a loop feeding back; an Input end on a shared trunk stops a run drawing from the wrong side.

Decoys, the compass and traps

BSP-Core

What the decoy's owner sees

A Hollow Idol on its Decoy Power Base, 100 RF a tick, with a faint ghost of the totem round it. Five per player.

What everyone else sees

An ordinary Shatter Totem. Rival compasses within range point at it. Try to steal it and its traps go off.

Decoy sockets: coils for range, charges for traps, an amplifier to make them worse, casings to make it tougher

Vault, screens and admin blocks

BSP-Core

Coin Vault, joined

Vault blocks of one owner join into one vault of up to 3 x 3 x 3. Coins inside earn interest. Rivals can pick the lock for a quarter of the coins.

Anti Totem Block

For admins: keeps Shatter Totems and chosen BSP blocks out of a box of up to 256 blocks in each direction. Spawn, hubs, arenas.

Score Screen. An admin block, placed from the creative menu: shows the live leaderboard, the rules, or the season's prizes. Every totem scores by its tier.

Admin Rack, or /bsp admin. Every player's totems, positions and vault coins, with teleport and reset. End a season from it: the top three get the prizes you placed, everyone gets a fresh totem.

One config file, serverconfig/bsp_core-server.toml, holds every cost, time, range and price. Optional MySQL or MariaDB links several servers into one season.

Moderators get a read-only admin view. /bsp totem buff and /bsp totem tier set powers for testing.
